regions.name: chair

regions.name: monitor
regions._note: Row 1 col 2, the 'monitor glowing blue' unit cropped to the MONITOR itself (screen + bezel + stand + the desk-edge it sits on), h=108 -- NOT the full-workstation composite the earlier #50 draft shipped (that box ran h=233 down through the keyboard, desk surface and drawers, which made 'CRT monitor' a near-duplicate of the separate 'desk' deliverable and drew moneta's send-back). Citation adopted from the independently-verified isolated crt-monitor of the reconciled-away PR #51 (branch t-141-office-sprites, manifest-desk.json crt-monitor 650,12,350,108), which moneta's own pass blessed as the properly-isolated one. Rectifies to a legible 37x11 sprite: a glowing blue-green screen in a dark bezel on a widening stand/desk-contact base, zero edge fabrication, structure verified at matched zoom (the earlier fear that an isolated monitor mode-votes to an indistinct blob applied to a much tighter screen-only ~13x10 crop, not this screen+bezel+stand region). Own group/palette per THE PALETTE LAW, distinct subject from the plain 'desk' group above.
